title: Does it make sense to switch to a Github Alternative ?
content_html:
I think a missing piece is that really most projects should have a mailing list with a nice web archive.

And those are a bit of a pain to self-host, and IMHO there aren't so many good services around.

I increasingly think that projects should run a small tilde (for project members) which does Git hosting, internal email services (mail accounts and a mailing list with an archive), perhaps some Git hook-based CI, and maybe static web hosting. I started setting up something like that with the intention of creating a blueprint to make it easy to replicate, but I got lost in some weeds.

(A tilde is interesting because then you can also allow project members to run a bouncer there to participate in support IRC channels, maybe do some shell stuff- maybe run some long-running processes in the tilde if they are needed for developing the projects, etc.)

I think back-in-the-day such setups were popular; e.g. Debian does something like that still. And I think nowadays it's easier to get a decent VPS that can support a few dozens of devs...

content_html_zh:
我认为缺少的一点是，大多数项目实际上应该有一个包含良好网络存档的邮件列表。

这些对于自助托管来说有点痛苦，而且恕我直言，周围没有那么多好的服务。

我越来越认为项目应该运行一个小波形符（对于项目成员），它可以执行 Git 托管、内部电子邮件服务（邮件帐户和带有存档的邮件列表）、也许是一些基于 Git 挂钩的 CI，也可能是静态 Web 托管。 我开始建立类似的东西，目的是创建一个蓝图以使其易于复制，但我迷失在一些杂草中。

（波浪号很有趣，因为这样你还可以允许项目成员在那里运行一个保镖来参与支持 IRC 频道，也许做一些 shell 的东西 - 如果开发项目需要的话，可以在波浪号中运行一些长时间运行的进程，等等。）

我认为这种设置在当时很流行。例如Debian 仍然在做类似的事情。 我认为现在获得一个像样的 VPS 可以支持几十个开发人员更容易......
